title: BEEBARK AI POLICY & AI TERMS OF USE

blocks.text: This AI Policy and AI Terms of Use (“AI Terms” or “Policy”) govern the use of artificial intelligence, machine-learning, generative-AI and related automated technologies made available through the BeeBark platform, website, application and related services (“Platform”).

These AI Terms form an integral part of the BeeBark User Agreement (“User Agreement”). By accessing or using any BeeBark AI feature, you agree to these AI Terms in addition to the User Agreement and BeeBark Privacy Policy.
If you do not agree to these AI Terms, you must not use BeeBark’s AI-enabled features.

Beebark Tech LLP, having its registered office at 249, First Floor, Kandle Kashan Fatehpuri, Chandni Chowk, Chandni Chowk Police Station, Delhi, North Delhi – 110006, India, is referred to as “BeeBark”, “we”, “us” or “our”.
The person using an AI feature is referred to as “User”, “you” or “your”.
